objects.name: Analytic 1702
objects.description: For Android, detect Proxy Through Victim by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]; Network Traffic Flow via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: VPN client, enterprise proxy agent, MDM agent with tunnel capability. Derive from MDM catalog. Tightening: only MDM-provisioned VPN apps.
Default 5s between inbound session and outbound relay connection. Proxy relay is near-synchronous. Tightening: 2s.
Default 3 distinct outbound destinations per inbound session. Single-destination relay may be VPN; multi-destination fan-out is proxy.
